historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved with conditions, 6-0, lifting the senior age restriction from the built planned unit development on the block bounded by Montgomery, Lombard, Winthrop and Chestnut Streets, changing its parking, and converting about 10,000 square feet of its commercial space to storage, exercise, social and management rooms for the residents (Motion 13938).
